items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: And Emil said, “That’s too bad you can’t do that because he won’t hire a guy if he can’t do that.

ctx.x: And he was awfully kind to me because a vibraphone player, Johnny Ray, was leaving. And so he said, “What is your vote on George?” I said, “I don’t know.” Because prior to Johnny, a vibraphone player being with him — I’m just trying to think of his name — and George wasn’t too generous in those days as regards to them playing. He would give them eight bars here and eight bars there you know, that kind of thing. So this guy came for my dinner this night, to my house for dinner, and he said, “Wait ‘till I get to…
